name: Fidelity National Information Services
outlook:
What Fidelity National Information Services says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted growthFor the full-year, the Company is updating its outlook, projecting Adjusted revenue growth of 28 - 29%, Adjusted EBITDA growth of 29 - 30% and Adjusted EPS growth of 1.2 - 2.4%.
  • Full year 2026: pro forma growthOn a Pro Forma basis, revenue is projected to grow 3.1 - 3.6% and Adjusted EBITDA is projected to grow 2.9 - 3.6% 2 .
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowAdditionally, the Company is maintaining its target for Free Cash Flow 1 of $2.15 - $2.25 billion, or growth of 33 - 39% as compared to the prior year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
